question: In whose ashram did the Beatles compose rock music in 1968 influenced by classical music?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Maharshi Mahesh Yogi Ashram**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The Beatles visited the **Maharshi Mahesh Yogi Ashram** in **Rishikesh**, India, in **1968**.
 
• During their stay, they composed numerous songs influenced by classical Indian music and culture.</li
